title: pasania pallida
intro:
Pasania pallida, commonly known as Indian beech or pasania, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. The plant is known for its various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pasania pallida are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, cough, and other respiratory problems, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.

Note: The information provided is based on available data, and it's essential to consult a medical professional before using any plant for therapeutic purposes.
